title: U.S. Citizen Who Deleted Phone’s Data Says His Prosecution Puts Privacy at Risk
summary: Samuel Tunick, who faces a felony charge for deleting his phone’s data during an airport customs search, called the government’s peering into people’s private lives “creepy.”
